assignment_topic: Should students be allowed to use smartphones during class?
introduction: Smartphones are becoming common in classrooms, and students often use them to search for information during lessons. Some teachers worry that phones can create distractions, especially when games or social media interrupt learning. However, these devices can also support classroom activities when teachers set clear rules. Students should be allowed to use smartphones during class for teacher-approved learning tasks because they can help students find information and practice lessons.
body:
First, smartphones help students during classroom activities. For example, a teacher can ask students to look up a difficult word in an online dictionary. Students can read the meaning and explain it to their classmates. This gives them information they can use during the lesson.

Second, smartphones can help students practice lessons.
one_sentence: Second, smartphones can help students practice lessons.
developed:
First, smartphones help students during classroom activities. For example, a teacher can ask students to look up a difficult word in an online dictionary. Students can read the meaning and explain it to their classmates. This gives them information they can use during the lesson.

Second, smartphones can help students practice lessons. A teacher can assign a short vocabulary task on a phone. Students explain their answers to a classmate and discuss what they learned.
